summary: A BSE currency future: BCD subscribes as bse_cd and its packets, scaled by that exchange's own divider, come out as the Quote frame.

deviations.reason: The web's Kotak adapter puts no mode in data; the desktop sends the label (ltp, quote, full). The key follows the broker's web adapter; set in the per-broker dialect entry (lane wire) in Phase B.
The web's Quote frame carries the market picture's OI (0 for an equity); the desktop's Quote tick carries OI only while a Depth subscription holds the instrument.
The web sends the packet's own net change percent (nc) as percent_change for every scrip; the desktop's carrier keeps a change only for an index, so an equity or a derivative frame has none.
